games.name: Anomic
games.desc:
Thrown into the anarchy of a desert town surrounded by the nothingness of Nevada, you are meant to stand on your own legs to earn money through many different ways. Join the Sheriff department and keep the crime behind a line, become a Trucker and help get goods to where they belong, open up your own shop selling a variety of items to other players, or be a Criminal hiding in the canyons to make cash through illegal ways.

Anomic is set in 1992.

Make sure to read the rules! https://devforum.roblox.com/t/-/2452477 

Private servers provide a set of commands to their owners (some of those commands can be shared with the 'cmdwl' command).

games.name: Mining INC: Remastered
games.desc:
👷Welcome to Mining Inc Remastered!
an exciting team-based game set in the depths of the mine.

Whether you choose to take on the role of a skilled miner drilling tunnels, a hauler collecting precious minerals, or a forklift driver transporting crates to the ship, every player has a unique and vital role to play in this thrilling adventure.

With randomly generated terrain in each round, every game presents a new challenge and opportunity for exploration. But the key to success lies in teamwork, as you work together with your fellow miners to overcome obstacles and maximise your haul.

Get ready to experience the thrill of the mine in this exciting adventure, where each player's contribution is essential to your success.

Play Mining Inc Remastered today!

games.name: Lost Currents [Alpha]
games.desc:
Lost Currents 

Sail a boat with your friends and dive into the deep depths of the AZR sea. You venture down in an old diving helmet, searching for gold bars while the others watch the boat. But beware, predators lurk below, and the ocean holds dark secrets.
Work together to survive, uncover mysteries, and see how far your courage will take you.

Trial and error will be your guide.

Update v0.10.3
